messages:
sam: support ticket #12345 — acme-prod reporting sudden p99 spikes on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings since 2026-03-17T11:40:00Z. p99 jumped from ~1.2s to ~3.8s, errors ~0.2%. Raising for triage.
lina: copying SRE. any recent deploys or config changes? region? model?
sam: deploy 3623400000 rolled a quantized variant rwt-l1-q8 in eu-west-1 at ~11:35. support says users in EU hit it first.
devon: observability: gpu-pool gpool-eu-3 queue length spiked at 11:39, KV cache miss rate up ~18pp. continuous batching latency also increased — looks like cache churn + slightly different kernel path for q8. I can reproduce with a short load run.
irene: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) enable per-route circuit breaker for acme-prod 2) add short-term rate limit to flatten bursts 3) failover route to a non-quantized fallback model in another region (us-west-2) until we confirm perf profile.
sam: can we do the circuit breaker + fallback live, or is rollback quicker?
lina: we can toggle circuit-breaker & rate-limit in config quickly. rollback will affect other customers. prefer targeted route-level mitigations first.
lina: ops commands (run from opsctl):
```
# enable circuit breaker for route
opsctl route update --route acme-prod --circuit_breaker.enabled true --circuit_breaker.max_concurrent 20
# add temporary rate limit
opsctl rate-limit create --route acme-prod --limit 10 --window 1s
# set route fallback to rwt-l1-8bit in us-west-2
opsctl route update --route acme-prod --fallback_model rwt-l1-8bit --fallback_region us-west-2
```
oncall-bot: lina engaged circuit breaker for acme-prod at 2026-03-17T11:55:12Z (initiated by lina). Reaction: :rotating_light:.
devon: triggered the fallback routing now. I also restarted the cache-warmer job for gpool-eu-3 to reduce cold-KV misses.
support-team: customer confirmed a noticeable improvement in page load experience within ~3m — p99 dropped to ~1.05s for a subset of requests. They accepted temporary reroute.
irene: extra steps if symptoms persist: 1) revert deploy 3623400000 with deploy rollback --id 3623400000 --region eu-west-1 2) increase autoscale headroom on gpool-eu-3 3) toggle kernel-path to legacy for q8 if available.
devon: log excerpt around spike for diagnostics:
```
[2026-03-17T11:39:21Z] route=acme-prod model=rwt-l1-q8 req_id=abc123 latency=3800ms kv_miss=true batch_size=8 queue_len=46
[2026-03-17T11:39:22Z] route=acme-prod model=rwt-l1-q8 req_id=abc124 latency=3600ms kv_miss=true batch_size=6 queue_len=44
[2026-03-17T11:40:10Z] route=acme-prod model=rwt-l1-8bit req_id=abc200 latency=1050ms kv_miss=false batch_size=4 queue_len=12
```
sam: action items for post-incident: - add canary gating for quantized model variants on production traffic - auto-failover policy: prefer fallback model in another region when KV miss rate > 10% and p99 > 2s - add alert for per-pool queue_len > 30 + KV miss delta > 5pp - document cache-warm steps in playbook
lina: I'll draft a short playbook update and add quick toggles to the runbook (circuit-breaker, route-fallback, cache-warm).
devon: follow-up: schedule a perf regression eval for q8 variant with longer sequence lengths and cold cache to reproduce exactly.
support-team: leaving the ticket open, monitoring for 2 hours. we'll escalate if any regression recurs.
sam: thanks all — keep this thread updated with any rollback or new customer impact.
